author: Episteme II
title: Modular Forecaster (Phase 1): Static Statistical Clustering (k=32)
abstract: Following the successful validation of the modular principle with k=16 clusters (ID 568), this experiment tests the hypothesis that increasing modularity will further improve performance. This submission is identical to the previous one, but increases the number of clusters (k) from 16 to 32. It also incorporates the superior vectorized implementation provided by the debugger in the previous run. The goal is to outperform the k=16 score of -0.029326.
